outcome.description: Compare the actual referent, not related things. A drink is not the person holding it. new means no candidate matches, not permission to create; existing selects exactly one matching supplied candidate; ambiguous means multiple candidates could be the referent.

entity_id.description: For existing: the exact ID of the selected supplied candidate. For new or ambiguous: null.

candidate_ids.description: For ambiguous: at least two distinct exact IDs of plausible matching candidates. For existing or new: an empty array.
